paper.title: Influence of sample cell physisorption on measurements of hydrogen storage of carbon materials using a Sieverts apparatus

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-derivation of Figures 9-12 + apparatus): 10 rows. Five carbons: AC (commercial activated carbon, Fuzhou Yihuan, BET >1900 recorded as 1900), MWCNT, SWCNT, GNF (graphite nanofibers), GO (graphite oxide, ref 18); LaNi5 (metal hydride) and stainless-steel powder (non-carbon) correctly excluded. Ambient 295 K and 77 K, 7.5 MPa = 75 bar; values are AFTER sample-cell physisorption correction. uptake_type=unspecified. Calibration earned (He dead-volume + Benedict-Webb-Rubin EOS Z-correction + empty-cell physisorption subtraction + LaNi5 verification). AC 77 K ~4 wt% is a figure-read supercritical maximum (Fig 11) with peak pressure not stated -> pressure_unstated + uptake_bound=approximate. The non-AC carbons at 77 K are collectively 'less than 1 wt%' (Fig 12) -> uptake_bound=upper, 1.0. Agent B caught a numeric swap on the ambient row pair: the paper reads '0.35, 0.2, 0.1 wt% for SWCNTs, GO, GNFs respectively', so GO=0.2 and GNF=0.1; the generator had them transposed. Agent C ACCEPTED: GNF 0.2->0.1, GO 0.1->0.2. Agent C also: surface_area_method none->not_reported on the four non-AC samples (the paper reports AC's BET area, so the others are 'not reported for this sample' under the S8.8/S11.1 partition, not 'none'); extraction_method table_direct->text_direct (figure-read, no uptake table). Tiers: the five ambient rows and the AC 77 K row Tier B (6/10); the four non-AC 77 K upper-bound rows Tier C (5/10) -- with no BET area the cryogenic Chahine bound cannot be assessed (scorer cryo_no_area=1). Agent B argued those four should be B; Agent C declined and kept C, because there is no area against which to grade the 77 K value. Final: 6 B / 4 C.

notes.ac77: AC 77 K ~4 wt% is the figure-read supercritical maximum (Fig 11), peak pressure not stated -> pressure_unstated + uptake_bound=approximate

notes.up77: at 77 K the paper states the non-AC carbons are 'less than 1 wt%' (collective, Fig 12) -> uptake_bound=upper, 1.0 wt% [flag Agent B]
